design: Tier 2: migration 0129 reaches the operator's :8000 on its next restart (that database is at 0109 today, so it will run 20 migrations then). Measured mode=ro 2026-10-16: 32 ok Claude worker rows (16 checkpoint 490,179 + 16 probe 472,420 = 962,599 tokens, $1.17) and no project with a token_budget, so the backfill raises totals and pauses nothing. Rollback: downgrade drops total_tokens and rewrites budget_exhausted rows as spawn_failed (error is already set), then restores the old CHECK. D1: WorkerUsage gains normalised_total(cli); worker._record (made public as record_invocation) writes it; the migration backfills by the same rule in SQL. D2: usage_accounting.used_tokens = measured turn sum + worker sum (None when both None); project_budget_state, accounting_snapshot['budget'] and the PATCH answer read it; accounting_snapshot gains workers lines (kind, input, output, total, measured_calls, unmeasured_calls, api_equivalent_usd_micros), ordered by kind; a measured call has a total, an unmeasured one spawned (ok, nonzero_exit, timeout, unparseable, schema_invalid) with none; non-spawning outcomes are neither. D3: run_worker(initiator=) is keyword-only with no default; an autonomous call reads project_budget_state first, fail-closed. Initiators: checkpoint operator iff trigger operator, probe inherits; distillation operator iff distil_requested (its transcription, pieces and contradiction check alike); spec-vault-check operator iff requested; report reviews and titles autonomous. D3a: consider() reads the budget lazily (memoised, only under the automatic policy) at both 'not policy.automatic' tests; consider_handover declines after its enabled check, before resolving the runner, so the note is not consumed. D4: the titler's one_shot('title') gains the JSON flag (claude --output-format json, codex --json), spawns through worker._run_worker_process, parses with the adapter's parse_one_shot, is gated as autonomous, and records a conversation_title row (prompt_version conversation-title/1) besides its manager firing. UI: the Budgets section lists the worker lines; the headline caption names worker calls.

checked: :8000 mode=ro 2026-10-16: alembic 0109; worker rows 16 checkpoint + 16 probe, all Claude ok, 962,599 tokens; no token_budget set
project_budget_state and accounting_snapshot sum TurnUsage only (usage_accounting.py)
seven run_worker callers (checkpoint, probe, distillation x3, reports, spec check), none budget-aware
the titler records only a manager firing; its Claude and Codex commands print plain text, so no usage
limits: Codex and Copilot workers are not driven at home beyond unit tests

problem: The budget reads turns only: project_budget_state and accounting_snapshot sum TurnUsage.total_tokens, and worker_invocations is joined to no aggregate. No worker consults the budget: run_worker checks the CLI and model, then spawns, and five callers spend autonomously (automatic checkpoints and handovers, distillation on upload, contradiction checks, report reviews, spec-vault checks). The titler records no worker row at all (Claude and Codex titles run in plain-text mode, so their usage is unrecoverable). F240 drove it: token_budget below usage, 'Autonomous turns are paused' on screen, and a checkpoint plus its probe spent $0.042 that reached no total and no budget. A Claude worker's input_tokens excludes cache (2 input against 47,091 cache reads), so input + output would under-count a worker ~100x against how a turn is counted.

requirements.rationale: A worker's cost must be recoverable and counted on the same basis as a turn's.
requirements.statement: Every model call the Hub makes for a project outside an agent turn, the conversation titler included, MUST be recorded as a worker invocation whose total_tokens is the call's tokens normalised as a turn's are (Claude: input plus cache reads and writes plus output; Codex: input plus output, cache already inside input), and null when the call reported no token count.

requirements.rationale: One meaning for the budget: everything the Hub spends for the project.
requirements.statement: A project's used tokens MUST be its measured turn tokens plus its worker totals, read the same by the budget, the accounting snapshot and the budget update; the snapshot MUST carry one `workers` line per worker kind, ordered by kind, with its tokens, measured and unmeasured calls and cost, and the project totals MUST include them while the per-agent and per-conversation figures stay turns only.

requirements.rationale: The rule the budget already applies to turns: autonomy pauses, the operator keeps control.
requirements.statement: When the project's token budget is exhausted, or cannot be read, a worker call the operator did not request MUST NOT be spawned and MUST be recorded with outcome budget_exhausted (or spawn_failed naming the unreadable budget), while a call the operator requested (the Checkpoint button, Distil, a requested spec check) MUST still run and be counted.

requirements.rationale: An unwritten checkpoint made at exhaustion would become the next checkpoint's anchor and consume a handover's notes.
requirements.statement: At exhaustion (or an unreadable budget) an automatic context-pressure checkpoint MUST NOT be generated: that reading MUST behave as under the offered policy (the due warning, a dismissal honoured, the final warning near the window); and a flow handover MUST decline without creating a checkpoint, leaving the author's note unconsumed.

requirements.rationale: The operator's existing worker spend (962,599 tokens on :8000) must count from the upgrade, not only from new calls.
requirements.statement: The migration MUST fill total_tokens for existing worker rows by the same rule, leave a row with no input and no output count null, and admit the budget_exhausted outcome; its downgrade MUST drop the column and turn budget_exhausted rows into spawn_failed.

in_scope: migration 0129: worker_invocations.total_tokens (backfilled) and the outcome budget_exhausted
the normalised total written for every worker row (Claude: input + cache read + cache write + output; Codex: input + output; Copilot one-shot: none)
run_worker's required initiator and its budget gate (fail-closed); every caller names its initiator
checkpoint_trigger.consider and checkpoint_handover.consider_handover read the budget before generating
the titler runs in JSON mode, is gated, and records a conversation_title worker row
accounting: used tokens = turns + workers; `workers` lines; project totals and budget include them; the Budgets section and headline caption show them
non_goals: Copilot credits on the worker lines, the project credit totals, and the `credits` display kind (slice B, F665)
Worker calls in a conversation's own usage rollup (it stays that conversation's turns)
Re-running a handover declined at exhaustion once the budget is raised

summary: Every model call the Hub makes for a project outside a turn (checkpoint, probe, conversation title, the vault jobs) is recorded with one normalised token total; those totals join the project total and the token budget as per-kind `workers` lines; at exhaustion an autonomous worker call is not spawned (recorded `budget_exhausted`) while an operator-requested one runs, and the automatic checkpoint triggers warn instead of generating (F240; decision fix-D2, option C of D7). Slice A of D2: Copilot credits on the worker lines and the `credits` display kind (F665) are slice B. Re-authored from openspec worker-spend-counts-against-the-budget.
